name: Stark Riedesel
biography: Stark Riedesel is a senior consultant at Synopsys with six years of security industry experience. He has filled a variety of roles, including penetration tester, researcher, lecturer, and security architect. Stark’s active areas of research are public and private blockchain platforms, NoSQL-based exploitation techniques, and container orchestration. Outside work,Stark speaks and hosts CTF events at the Dallas, Texas, OWASP chapter and local universities.
